high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post. The main focus is on a wall with a large, bold text painted in black and pink. The text reads "L'AMOUR C'EST TOUT," which translates from French to "LOVE IS EVERYTHING." The background of the text is a light pink color, and the letters are outlined in black, giving them a strong, impactful appearance. Below the image, there is a caption that reads: "I went to the Garden of Love and saw what I never had seen" by a user named alessandro_michele. The post has received significant engagement
